Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the CommunityController class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Progress Software has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Progress Software WhatsUp Gold CommunityController Unrestricted File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Progress Software WhatsUp Gold. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the CommunityController class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
